dark_wave.name: Dark Wave
dark_wave.description: Give the blade to the dark and let it loose in a wave. It breaks over every enemy in the room, and the dark takes an eighth of your own life for it.
dark_wave.cast_message: {caster_name} draws the dark blade and looses a wave of shadow!
dark_wave.hit_message: The wave breaks over {target_name} for {value} damage!

cure.name: Cure
cure.self_heal_message: A warm light closes your wounds, restoring {value} health!

fog_breath.name: Fog Breath
fog_breath.cast_message: {caster_name} exhales a rolling bank of fog!

call_titan.name: Call Titan
call_titan.description: Reach across the gap and call a titan to your side. The calling takes a quarter of your life to make.
call_titan.cast_message: {caster_name} sings the calling, and the ground answers...

bat_screech.name: Screech
bat_screech.description: A shriek that rattles the skull.
